amendments.name: Amendment a
amendments.summary: The overall rationale for the changes implemented in this protocol amendment is to address feedback received from an internal safety committee.

changes.name: Section 5.2 Exclusion Criteria
changes.summary:
Exclusion Criterion #16: removed "Exception: Short_term treatment with insulin for <14 days is allowed for certain clinical situations, such as, elective surgery, during hospitalization, hyperosmolar states, or acute illness."
Edited Exclusion Criterion #36 to remove ", except for the use of insulin for treatment of gestational diabetes or acute, temporary use of insulin (≤14 days), for example, for acute illness, hospitalization, elective surgery."
Edited Exclusion Criterion #40 to add "Note: Insulin therapy is not allowed within 90 days prior to Visit 1."

changes.name: Section 6.9.1 Initiation of new Antihyperglycemic Medications
changes.summary: Added "Insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited."

changes.name: Section 6.9.2 Rescue Therapy for Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia
changes.summary:
Updated from "Participants should" to "Participants must" continue administering assigned study intervention, and added clarification "unless insulin is used as short_term rescue therapy."
Updated Recommended glycemic rescue therapy section to state that urgent use of short_term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy, and added respective instructions to temporarily interrupt study intervention.
Removed "Short_term treatment with insulin not as rescue therapy" section.

changedSections.sectionTitle: Rescue Therapy for Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia

changes.name: Section 6.9.3 Prohibited Medications
changes.summary: Updated Note regarding short_term insulin use to clarify that it is allowed for urgent use.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Age requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participant must be at least 18 years of age and of the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction in which the study is taking place at the time of signing the informed consent.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Type 2 diabetes diagnosis
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a clinical diagnosis of T2D according to the World Health Organization (WHO) classification or other locally applicable standards for at least 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1), with HbA1c ≤10.0% (86 mmol/mol) at screening (Visit 1).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Stable T2D treatment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are on stable treatment for T2D for at least 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1), consisting of either diet/exercise alone or up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins). Note: DPP_4i are allowed.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: BMI requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a BMI >27 kg/m2 at Visit 1. Note: In participants with limb amputation or limb loss, the investigator should reach out to the Lilly medical monitor for information regarding calculation of BMI.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Stable body weight
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a stable body weight (<5% body weight change) for 90 days prior to screening at Visit 1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: History of unsuccessful dietary effort
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of at least 1 self_reported unsuccessful dietary effort to reduce body weight.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Contraceptive requirements
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: IOCBP, INOCBP, and individuals AMAB who agree to abide by the reproductive and contraceptive requirements provided in Section 10.4. may participate in this trial. See Section 10.4 for definitions and additional requirements related to contraception. Note: Contraceptive use by participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. For the contraception requirements of this protocol, see Section 10.4.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Informed consent capability
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are capable of giving signed informed consent as described in Appendix 1, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Reliability and willingness to comply
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are reliable and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and attend required study visits, and are willing and able to follow study procedures as required, such as self_inject study intervention; store and take the provided study intervention as directed; maintain electronic study diary and paper log; complete the required questionnaires; and undergo DXA procedure. Note: if a person is unable to undergo the DXA due to physical limitations of the DXA machine, or because they have implants, hardware, or other foreign materials that may interfere with the scan according to the DXA manufacturer's specification, this will not be considered an exclusionary criterion. See Section 8.1.2 for further details.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity. Exception: The following are allowed if performed >1 year before screening (Visit 1): liposuction; cryolipolysis; or abdominoplasty.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Prior or planned endoscopic/device_based therapy for obesity
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a prior or planned endoscopic procedure and/or device_based therapy for obesity, such as, but not limited to mucosal ablation; gastric artery embolization; laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding; intragastric balloon; or duodenal_jejunal endoluminal liner. Exception: Prior device_based therapy is acceptable if device removal was more than 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Obesity induced by endocrinologic disorders or monogenetic/syndromic forms
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have obesity induced by other endocrinologic disorders, for example, Cushing Syndrome, or are diagnosed with monogenetic or syndromic forms of obesity, for example, Melanocortin 4 Receptor deficiency or Prader Willi Syndrome.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Type 1 diabetes or related conditions
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have type 1 diabetes mellitus, latent autoimmune diabetes, or history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have had 1 or more episode of severe hypoglycemia and/or 1 or more episode of hypoglycemia unawareness within the 180 days prior to Visit 1. Note: Any participant that the investigator feels will not be able to communicate an understanding of hypoglycemic symptoms and the appropriate treatment of hypoglycemia should also be excluded.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: High fasting glucose
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have fasting glucose >270 mg/dL (>15.0 mmol/L) confirmed by the central laboratory at screening (Visit 1).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent use of prohibited antihyperglycemic medications
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have taken within 90 days before screening (Visit 1) any of the following AHMs: amylin analogs; GLP_1 receptor agonists; GIP/GLP receptor agonists; or insulin.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Current or planned treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are currently receiving or planning to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, for example, laser photocoagulation or intravitreal injections of antivascular endothelial growth factor inhibitors. Note: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment prior to randomization (Visit 3). Qualifying fundus photographs obtained within 90 days before Visit 1 may be used for eligibility determination. See Section 8.2.11.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Renal impairment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have renal impairment measured as eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, calculated by eGFRcr_cys formula as per Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration as determined by central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Significant active autoimmune abnormality
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have evidence of significant, active autoimmune abnormality, for example, lupus or rheumatoid arthritis, that, in the opinion of the investigator, is likely to require concurrent treatment with systemic glucocorticoids during the course of the study.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent cardiovascular events
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have had within 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1): acute myocardial infarction.

medicalDevices.name: Prefilled Syringe (PFS)
medicalDevices.label: Electronic Diary
medicalDevices.description: Electronic diary device provided to participants to record hypoglycemic events, 7_point SMBG values, and weekly study medication injections; returned at participant's last visit

medicalDevices.name: Blood glucose meter
medicalDevices.label: BG Meter
medicalDevices.description: Blood glucose meter dispensed to participants for self_monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG); supplies dispensed as needed throughout the study; diabetes education and SMBG training provided

medicalDevices.name: Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM)
medicalDevices.label: CGM
medicalDevices.description: Continuous glucose monitoring device used in the CGM substudy (Appendix 9) for continuous blood glucose monitoring via subcutaneous sensor

medicalDevices.name: DXA Scanner
medicalDevices.label: ECG Machine
medicalDevices.description: Central 12_lead electrocardiogram device used for cardiac monitoring at specified visits

medicalDevices.name: Electronic diary device
medicalDevices.label: DXA Scanner
medicalDevices.description: Dual_energy x_ray absorptiometry machine used for body composition assessment; participants with implants, hardware, or foreign materials may be excluded per manufacturer specifications

medicalDevices.name: Fundus Camera
medicalDevices.label: Fundus Camera
medicalDevices.description: Fundus photography equipment used for diabetic retinopathy screening and evaluation

medicalDevices.name: Autoinjector / Injection Device
medicalDevices.label: Study Intervention Injection Device
medicalDevices.description: Injection device used by participants for weekly subcutaneous self_injection of study intervention; injection training provided at Visit 3 and repeated as needed; supplies dispensed and returned per schedule

medicalDevices.name: Interactive Web Response System
medicalDevices.label: IWRS
medicalDevices.description: Interactive web response system used for participant registration, randomization to treatment, and dispensing of study intervention at each visit

studyInterventions.name: Eloralintide
studyInterventions.description: Selective, long_acting amylin receptor agonist administered as once_weekly subcutaneous injection for treatment of obesity/overweight with T2D. Doses: 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg QW with dose_escalation regimen stepping through doses every 4 weeks to reach target doses of 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg.

studyInterventions.name: Placebo
studyInterventions.description: Matching placebo administered subcutaneously once weekly via prefilled syringe

studyInterventions.name: Oral antihyperglycemic medications (AHMs)
studyInterventions.description: Up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins, except DPP_4i are allowed) on stable treatment for at least 90 days prior to screening. Permitted as background therapy for T2D management.

studyInterventions.name: New antihyperglycemic medications
studyInterventions.description: Initiation of new AHMs permitted during study per Section 6.9.1. Insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited.

studyInterventions.name: Short_term insulin (rescue)
studyInterventions.description: Urgent use of short_term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy for severe, persistent hyperglycemia. Study intervention must be temporarily interrupted when insulin is used as short_term rescue therapy.

studyInterventions.name: Antihypertensive medications
studyInterventions.description: Permitted concomitant medications; doses recorded at each visit.

studyInterventions.name: Lipid_lowering medications
studyInterventions.description: Permitted concomitant medications; doses recorded at each visit.

studyInterventions.name: Amylin analogs
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited within 90 days before screening (Visit 1); washout required.

studyInterventions.name: GLP_1 receptor agonists
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited within 90 days before screening (Visit 1); washout required.

studyInterventions.name: GIP/GLP receptor agonists
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited within 90 days before screening (Visit 1); washout required.

studyInterventions.name: Insulin
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited within 90 days before screening (Visit 1). Insulin therapy is not allowed within 90 days prior to Visit 1. During study, insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited.

studyInterventions.name: Surgical/procedural/pharmacological weight management treatments
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited surgical treatments, procedures, or medications for weight management per Section 6.9.4.

studyInterventions.name: Systemic glucocorticoids
studyInterventions.description: Concurrent treatment with systemic glucocorticoids for significant active autoimmune abnormality is exclusionary.

studyInterventions.name: Micronutrient repletion
studyInterventions.description: Micronutrient deficiencies identified via laboratory tests should be repleted as clinically appropriate per Section 5.3.2.
